description: This Java class defines an Android activity for Wear OS devices that prompts users to open permission settings on their paired phone. It extends WearableActivity and mainly handles a button click to set the result and finish.

classes.name: RequestPermissionOnPhoneActivity
classes.description: An activity for Wear OS that prompts the user to open permission settings on the paired phone. Handles a button click to acknowledge the permission request.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and enables ambient mode.

methods.name: onClickPermissionPhoneStorage
methods.description: Handles click event, sets result code to OK, and finishes the activity.
